edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in the constructor.
The initial owner is derived from msg.sender, granting privileged role control.
Constructor chain (Ownable) initializes the owner state variable.
Constructor assigns the immutable Uniswap V2 router.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap V2 pair.
Constructor sets maxTransactionAmount from total supply.
Constructor sets maxWallet from total supply.
Constructor sets the swap threshold amount.
Constructor sets buyTotalDevFees from buy fee components.
Constructor sets sellTotalDevFees from sell fee components.
Constructor assigns dev1Wallet payable address.
Constructor assigns marketingWallet payable address.
Constructor minting increases total supply.
Constructor minting credits the deployer balance.
Constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, contract, dead and marketing addresses.
Constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction for router, pair and privileged addresses.
Constructor registers the newly created pair as an AMM pair.
enableTrading sets tradingActive to true.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled to true.
removeLimits clears limitsInEffect.
removeLimits clears gasLimitActive.
removeLimits clears transferDelayEnabled.
disableTransferDelay clears transferDelayEnabled.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount reads totalSupply for bounds checks.
updateMaxAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxAmount reads totalSupply for the lower bound check.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes the exclusion mapping.
updateSwapEnabled writes swapEnabled.
excludeFromFees writes the fee exclusion mapping.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair reads uniswapV2Pair for the guard.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the AMM pair mapping.
tx.origin is used as the key of _holderLastTransferTimestamp, making the anti-bot check origin dependent.
_transfer reads the last transfer block for tx.origin.
_transfer writes the current block number for tx.origin.
_transfer reads tradingActive to gate transfers before launch.
_transfer reads swapEnabled to decide whether to swap back.
_transfer reads limitsInEffect to apply anti-whale limits.
_transfer reads the swapping guard flag.
_transfer sets and clears the swapping guard around swapBack.
_transfer reads transferDelayEnabled to apply the per-block purchase delay.
_transfer reads gasLimitActive to enforce the gas price cap.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to decide fee applicability.
_transfer reads _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount for limit exemptions.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify buys and sells.
_transfer reads maxTransactionAmount for buy/sell caps.
_transfer reads maxWallet for the holding cap.
_transfer reads swapTokensAtAmount to compute canSwap.
_transfer reads buyTotalDevFees for buy fee computation.
_transfer reads sellTotalDevFees for sell fee computation.
_transfer reads and accumulates tokensForDev1.
_transfer increments tokensForDev1 from collected fees.
_transfer reads and accumulates tokensForMarketing.
_transfer increments tokensForMarketing from buy fees.
from parameter flows into _transfer logic.
to parameter flows into _transfer logic.
amount parameter flows into _transfer logic.
_transfer computes and assigns the fees local variable.
_transfer calls swapBack when the contract balance exceeds the swap threshold.
amount is used in the mul/div fee arithmetic.
buyTotalDevFees/sellTotalDevFees participate in the fee arithmetic.
The fees local variable is the result of the fee arithmetic.
fees is subtracted from amount after accounting.
amount is mutated by the -= fees operation.
_transfer performs the amount -= fees arithmetic.
Fee arithmetic result is credited to tokensForDev1.
swapTokensForEth reads the router address.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap.
addLiquidity reads the router address.
addLiquidity uses block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
addLiquidity invokes the external router addLiquidityETH.
swapBack reads accumulated token buckets for distribution.
swapBack reads tokensForMarketing for distribution.
swapBack reads dev1Wallet as the ETH transfer target.
swapBack reads marketingWallet as the ETH transfer target.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert tokens to ETH.
swapBack sends ETH to dev and marketing wallets via low-level call, enabling reentrancy before the guard is released.
forceSwapBack calls swapBack after the owner check.
forceSwapBack reads totalSupply for its threshold requirement.
forceSwapBack emits block.timestamp in the OwnerForcedSwapBack event.
buyBackTokens reads the router address.
buyBackTokens uses block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
buyBackTokens invokes the external router swapExactETHForTokens call.
renounceOwnership clears the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
newAmount parameter is validated and stored by updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
newNum parameter is validated and stored by updateMaxAmount.
totalTokensToSwap is computed inside swapBack from token buckets.
tokenAmount parameter supplies the swap input for swapTokensForEth.
account parameter determines the fee-exclusion mapping key.
pair parameter determines the AMM pair mapping key.
contractBalance local variable is read from balanceOf inside swapBack.
ethAmountInWei parameter supplies the ETH value for buyBackTokens.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer; merge into the _transfer core node.
The to parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer; merge into the _transfer core node.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer; merge into the _transfer core node.
The fees local variable is the direct product of the fee arithmetic operation; merge into the unsafe fee computation node.
newAmount is the sole parameter of updateSwapTokensAtAmount; merge into that function node.
newNum is the sole parameter of updateMaxAmount; merge into that function node.
totalTokensToSwap is computed and consumed only inside swapBack; merge into the swapBack node.
tokenAmount is the sole parameter of swapTokensForEth; merge into that function node.
account is the target parameter of excludeFromFees; merge into that function node.
pair is the target parameter of setAutomatedMarketMakerPair; merge into that function node.
contractBalance is a local read used only inside swapBack; merge into the swapBack node.
ethAmountInWei is the sole parameter of buyBackTokens; merge into that function node.
